source.paraphrase: An anti-corruption layer translates the upstream model into the local one. Callers of the layer see the local model, not the foreign types.

invariants.why: Re-exporting the foreign type lets the rest of the system depend on the other model's names, which is the coupling the anti-corruption layer exists to stop.
invariants.fixHint: Import the foreign type privately, map it to a type this system owns, and export only that local type.
invariants.avoid: export type { X } from the package is still a re-export. A relative re-export of a local translation is fine.
